text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Five days until the Tryout Race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The item I had ordered—sturdy racing shoes capable of handling
Oguri Cap's immense power—had arrived, so I went to deliver them right away.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Shoes... for me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Why?
I'm not even your trainee yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Tamamo Cross had explained, I told her, "The Tryout Race is
a chance to show your full potential, and these are necessary for that..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see. Tama said that, did she...?
So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Thank you for your consideration.
I'll start breaking them in today to prepare for the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I watched over Oguri Cap for a while
as she ran in her new shoes...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah, hah—
Huh... Haha, hahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Incredible!! My legs... feel so light...!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Allow me to thank you once more.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. These are... the best shoes I've ever worn.
I will treasure them...!
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see you having fun running.
I'm glad you looked so happy while running.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh...? What is this...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No... it's just.
How should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It feels... strangely nostalgic...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah... No, sorry. Forget I said anything.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, thank you for the shoes.
I promise I'll give the Tryout Race everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And five days later...
The day of the Tryout Race had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Featuring the highly anticipated Oguri Cap and the rumored
formidable contender Super Creek, this Tryout Race—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Generated an atmosphere on par with a GⅠ race on the day...!
The immense fervor of the crowd was palpable!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My, what an incredible crowd of spectators~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no kidding. Is a Tryout Race
always this lively...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, it's usually not quite this packed...
I wonder if there's a celebrity here~...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A celebrity, huh... That makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Tryout Race Official A
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek-san!
It's time to get ready, please!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Okaay~.
Excuse me, then~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Right.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Who was that just now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite the massive spotlight on them,
both of them moved entirely at their own pace...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Yet when the race began,
they both dazzled the roaring crowd with an overwhelming display of speed!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is giving chase!
You'd never guess she had a slow start with a drive like this!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oguri pursues! Oguri pursues! Creek holds the lead!
Can she hold on?! Is it Oguri?! Or Creek—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, Oguri Cap finished in a close second,
just behind Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Second place, huh.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Even with new shoes, giving it everything I had...
I still only placed second...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. Once I debut, will I be able to run with
rivals like Tama and Creek all the time...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's truly amazing...
I can't wait...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap!
Great work out there, that was a spectacular run...!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, so powerful!
We would love to scout you for our team—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... right. To make my debut,
I have to be scouted first. That's how it worked...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, but... excuse me.
Please let me through.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clumsily parting through the crowd,
Oguri Cap made her way straight toward me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Did you watch my race?
choice_data_list: I was watching! You were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes, after all... it's just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—I have a favor to ask.
Will you be my Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Your words conveyed such genuine warmth to me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It felt nostalgic... like the earnest, heartfelt cheers
I used to receive from the folks back home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I thought... as long as you're watching over me, even here
so far from home, I can run with total peace of mind and all my strength.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...What do you say? Will you accept?
choice_data_list: Let's make everyone back home proud together!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah!
I'm counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All right, well then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grumbleeee...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...First, we need to get some food.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My days with this rustic, ravenous horsegirl, Oguri Cap,
were only just beginning...!
